FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Got questions? We’ve got answers to help you navigate your rental experience!

ITEM_1.QUESTION: How can I pay at Ghost Rentals?
ITEM_1.ANSWER: We accept Visa, MasterCard, AmEx, Cash, online banking & Bitcoin - choose what works best for you at Ghost Rentals!

ITEM_2.QUESTION: Which luxury supercars can I rent from Ghost Rentals?
ITEM_2.ANSWER: At Ghost Rentals, we offer an extensive fleet of premium & economy vehicles - all fully insured, impeccably maintained & inspected. Our 24/7 support team is always ready to help. Browse our complete catalog of luxury cars & yachts with no deposit required at the lowest market prices!

ITEM_3.QUESTION: How can I modify or cancel my Ghost Rentals reservation?
ITEM_3.ANSWER: Yes, you can modify or cancel your reservation by contacting our customer service team. All changes must be made at least 48 hours in advance. Modifications or cancellations requested with less than 48 hours notice may incur additional fees.

ITEM_4.QUESTION: What are Ghost Rentals late return fees and policies?
ITEM_4.ANSWER: We rent vehicles on a 24-hour basis with a 1-hour grace period for returns. After that, hourly charges apply. Beyond 3 hours late, full-day charges apply. No grace period for surcharges, fees, protections, or optional equipment - full-day late charges apply immediately for these items.

ITEM_5.QUESTION: Does Ghost Rentals provide roadside assistance if I encounter issues with my rental car?
ITEM_5.ANSWER: If you encounter issues with your Ghost Rentals vehicle, call us immediately. For minor problems, our operations team will assist on-site. For major malfunctions, we'll provide replacement or roadside assistance. Never abandon your vehicle - stay with the car and wait for our service team or authorities. Our 24/7 support ensures you're never stranded during your rental.

ITEM_6.QUESTION: How do I book a car and yacht rental with Ghost Rentals?
ITEM_6.ANSWER: Booking with Ghost Rentals is simple: visit ghostrentals.com, select your car, call us or email info@GhostRentals.com. No deposit required* with lowest prices!

ITEM_7.QUESTION: Can I book multiple vehicles at once from Ghost Rentals?
ITEM_7.ANSWER: Yes, you can book multiple vehicles at once with Ghost Rentals. Simply select your desired cars and complete the booking. Our team is ready to assist with any questions.

TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS.TITLE: Terms and Conditions
TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS.INTRODUCTION: Welcome to Ghost Rentals LLC! To ensure a smooth and enjoyable car rental experience, we've outlined our terms and conditions in a clear and easy-to-understand format. Please read them carefully before renting a vehicle.

CAR_DELIVERY_AND_PICKUP.TITLE: Car Delivery and Pickup
CAR_DELIVERY_AND_PICKUP.VEHICLE_CONDITION: Vehicle Condition: The car will be delivered to you in excellent condition, free of visible defects or damage, except for those noted in the provided inspection diagram.
CAR_DELIVERY_AND_PICKUP.RETURN_POLICY: Return Policy: The vehicle must be returned to Ghost Rentals in the same condition as it was delivered.

TERMS_OF_USE.TITLE: Terms of Use
TERMS_OF_USE.AGREEMENT: As a renter, you agree to the following terms:
TERMS_OF_USE.AUTHORIZED_DRIVERS: Authorized Drivers Only: Only individuals listed in the rental contract are permitted to drive the vehicle.
TERMS_OF_USE.PROHIBITED_ACTIVITIES: Prohibited Activities: The car must not be driven off-road, used for speed racing, rallying, or any other unauthorized activities.
TERMS_OF_USE.VEHICLE_MAINTENANCE: Vehicle Maintenance: You are responsible for conducting periodic inspections of the car and must inform Ghost Rentals of any issues. Failure to report problems and continuing to drive the car may result in liability for damages.
TERMS_OF_USE.PROHIBITED_GOODS: Prohibited Goods: The car must not be used to transport illegal or prohibited items, such as alcohol or drugs.

INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.TITLE: Insurance Exclusions
INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.DESCRIPTION: Insurance coverage will not apply in the following situations:
INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.UNDER_INFLUENCE: If the driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs at the time of an accident.
INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.UNAUTHORIZED_RENTAL: If the car is rented to another party without written consent from Ghost Rentals.
INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.INVALID_LICENSE: If the driver does not hold a valid driver's license.
INSURANCE_EXCLUSIONS.LIABILITY_NOTE: In these cases, the renter will be fully responsible for all damages to the vehicle and must comply with all traffic laws.

EXPENSES.TITLE: Expenses
EXPENSES.CHARGES_DESCRIPTION: The following charges and fees apply:
EXPENSES.RENTAL_CHARGES: Rental Charges: Time and mileage fees are calculated based on the applicable tariff at the time of rental.
EXPENSES.ADDITIONAL_FEES: Additional Fees: This includes traffic violations, Salik toll charges, vehicle delivery fees, and any other applicable expenses.
EXPENSES.FUEL_POLICY: Fuel Policy: The car will be delivered with a full fuel tank and must be returned in the same condition.
EXPENSES.PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION: Payment Authorization: By signing the rental agreement, you authorize Ghost Rentals to deduct all related expenses from your credit card, including charges incurred during and after the rental period.

ACCIDENTS_AND_THEFTS.TITLE: Accidents & Thefts
ACCIDENTS_AND_THEFTS.ACCIDENTS: Accidents: In the event of an accident or injury, you must immediately inform the police and have them inspect the accident site.
ACCIDENTS_AND_THEFTS.THEFT: Theft: If the vehicle or any part of it is stolen, notify the police immediately.
ACCIDENTS_AND_THEFTS.REPAIRS: Repairs: No repairs should be made to the vehicle without prior written consent from Ghost Rentals.

INSURANCE_COVERAGE.TITLE: Insurance Coverage
INSURANCE_COVERAGE.DESCRIPTION: Ghost Rentals provides insurance exclusively for licensed drivers listed in the rental agreement. The insurance policy complies with UAE car accident regulations and is available upon request.

BOOKING_MODIFICATIONS_AND_CANCELLATIONS.TITLE: Booking Modifications and Cancellations
BOOKING_MODIFICATIONS_AND_CANCELLATIONS.MODIFICATION_POLICY: You can modify or cancel your booking free of charge up to 48 hours before the rental start date.

SECURITY_DEPOSIT.TITLE: Security Deposit
SECURITY_DEPOSIT.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT: Deposit Amount: A refundable security deposit of AED 1,500 is required at the time of car pickup and must be paid via credit card.
SECURITY_DEPOSIT.REFUND_TIMELINE: Refund Timeline: The deposit will be refunded within 21 to 30 days after the car is returned.

REQUIRED_IDENTIFICATION.TITLE: Required Identification
REQUIRED_IDENTIFICATION.DESCRIPTION: To rent a car, you must provide the following documents:
REQUIRED_IDENTIFICATION.INTERNATIONAL_LICENSE: An international driving license (for non-Gulf citizens).

PAYMENT_POLICY.TITLE: Payment Policy
PAYMENT_POLICY.ACCEPTED_METHODS: Accepted Payment Methods: Only credit cards are accepted. Prepaid or debit cards are not allowed.
PAYMENT_POLICY.CARD_OWNERSHIP: Card Ownership: The credit card used for payment must belong to the renter and must be presented at the time of vehicle pickup or delivery.

FINAL_NOTE.AGREEMENT: By renting a vehicle from Ghost Rentals LLC, you agree to abide by these terms and conditions. If you have any questions or need further clarification, feel free to contact us at info@GhostRentals.com. Safe travels!
